start_policy: Cash until first new month-end; identical initial basket,20% slots,whole shares across policies for each cost/start. No replacements or reentry after exit.
cap_scope: 25% checked only at monthly execution; can drift between checks.
exit_rule: Reported fundamental means originalG/E/margin gates, without momentum. Relative strength means63-session stock return exceedsSPY; directional zero boundary, no tuning. Membership removal applies to all.
caveats: No expectations/thesis exit without released historical expectations
Static baskets are ablations, not implementable proof of repeatable5x selection
Annual accounts overlap; all history reused
